responsibility: This header declares the character-at-a-time standard I/O interface for the mc-boot runtime. It exports the default Read, Write, and Error procedures mapped to stdin/stdout/stderr plus the controls for toggling raw versus buffered terminal behavior and input echo on file descriptors, defining the low-level stream endpoint used by StdIO.
same_name_distinction: Declares the low-level standard-stream character API and terminal mode controls, while GIO.cc holds the fd state tracking, raw/buffered behavior, and termios-backed implementation.
